#' Fit the correlated-residual model from a fit without the correlation
#'
#' The model without correlated residuals, fitted from every start, places
#' the classes; the full likelihood is then maximized within the bounds of
#' `.growth_correlated_bounds()` by L-BFGS-B with the analytic scores, from
#' that fit with half of each residual variance moved to the process (at two
#' process rates), and finished by Newton steps on the free coordinates. A
#' coordinate left on a bound is a variance at its floor: the fit is a
#' boundary fit, warned about with `latents_random_boundary`, and judged
#' converged on its other coordinates.
#'
#' @param spec The correlated specification.
#' @param uncorrelated The fit without correlated residuals.
#' @param max_iter,tol Iteration bound and relative tolerance.
#' @return The fit, with `spec`, `stats`, `params` and the likelihood updated.
#' @noRd

    base <- uncorrelated$params
    gaps <- unlist(lapply(stats$raw$rows, function(r) diff(sort(spec$residual_times[r]))))
    gap <- if (any(gaps > 0)) 
        stats::median(gaps[gaps > 0])
    else 1
    floor <- spec$min_variance
    starts <- lapply(c(0.5, 2)/gap, function(rate) {
        params <- base
        params$sigma2 <- pmax(base$sigma2/2, 2 * floor)
        sd <- sqrt(max(mean(base$sigma2)/2, 2 * floor))
        params$correlation <- if (identical(spec$residual_correlation, "ar")) 
            c(rate = rate, sd = sd)
        else c(sd = sd)
        params
    })
    if (identical(spec$residual_correlation, "brownian")) 
        starts <- starts[1L]
    weights <- spec$sampling_weights %||% 1
    bounds <- .growth_correlated_bounds(spec, .growth_pack(spec, starts[[1L]]), gap)
    finishes <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
        theta <- pmin(pmax(.growth_pack(spec, start), bounds$lower), bounds$upper)
        objective <- function(v) {
            value <- tryCatch(.growth_expectation(spec, stats, .growth_unpack(spec, v, start))$log_likelihood, latents_singular_covariance = function(condition) -Inf)
            if (is.finite(value)) 
                -value
            else .Machine$double.xmax
        }
        gradient <- function(v) {
            current <- .growth_unpack(spec, v, start)
            tryCatch(-colSums(.growth_scores(spec, stats, current) * weights), latents_singular_covariance = function(condition) rep(0, length(v)))
        }
        fitted <- stats::optim(theta, objective, gradient, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = bounds$lower, upper = bounds$upper, control = list(maxit = max(100L, max_iter), factr = 10, pgtol = 0))
        list(params = .growth_unpack(spec, fitted$par, start), value = -fitted$value, iterations = as.integer(fitted$counts[["gradient"]]))
    })
    best <- finishes[[which.max(vapply(finishes, `[[`, numeric(1), "value"))]]
    newton <- .growth_correlated_newton(spec, stats, best$params, weights, bounds)
    expectation <- .growth_expectation(spec, stats, newton$params)
    if (length(newton$at_bound) > 0L) {
        warning(warningCondition(sprintf(paste("With correlated residuals, %s %s at %s floor (`min_variance`) or bound,", "or not identified: the data cannot separate the residual variance, the", "process and the random effects there. Their standard errors are not", "reported."), paste(sprintf("`%s`", newton$at_bound), collapse = ", "), if (length(newton$at_bound) == 1L) 
            "is"
        else "are", if (length(newton$at_bound) == 1L) 
            "its"
        else "their"), class = "latents_random_boundary", call = NULL))
    }
    if (!newton$converged) {
        warning(warningCondition(sprintf(paste("The correlated-residual model did not converge (largest score %.3g", "standard errors from its root); the estimates are not a maximum."), newton$displacement), class = "latents_unconverged", call = NULL))
    }
    fit <- uncorrelated
    fit$spec <- spec
    fit$stats <- stats
    fit$params <- newton$params
    fit$expectation <- expectation
    fit$log_likelihood <- expectation$log_likelihood
    fit$n_parameters <- .growth_count_parameters(spec)
    degenerate <- .growth_degenerate_covariances(spec, newton$params)
    fit$degenerate_classes <- degenerate

    fit$random_boundary <- length(degenerate) > 0L || length(newton$at_bound) > 0L

.growth_correlated_refit <- function(spec, uncorrelated, max_iter, tol) {
  stats <- .growth_statistics(spec)
  base <- uncorrelated$params
  gaps <- unlist(lapply(stats$raw$rows, function(r) diff(sort(spec$residual_times[r]))))
  gap <- if (any(gaps > 0)) stats::median(gaps[gaps > 0]) else 1
  floor <- spec$min_variance
  starts <- lapply(c(0.5, 2) / gap, function(rate) {
    params <- base
    params$sigma2 <- pmax(base$sigma2 / 2, 2 * floor)
    sd <- sqrt(max(mean(base$sigma2) / 2, 2 * floor))
    params$correlation <- if (identical(spec$residual_correlation, "ar"))
      c(rate = rate, sd = sd) else c(sd = sd)
    params
  })
  if (identical(spec$residual_correlation, "brownian")) starts <- starts[1L]
  weights <- spec$sampling_weights %||% 1
  bounds <- .growth_correlated_bounds(spec, .growth_pack(spec, starts[[1L]]), gap)
  finishes <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
    theta <- pmin(pmax(.growth_pack(spec, start), bounds$lower), bounds$upper)
    # V = Z G Z' + W + sigma^2 I is positive definite in exact arithmetic, but
    # a line search can try a process variance so far beyond sigma^2 that it
    # is singular in floating point, or overflows: either is a rejected step.
    objective <- function(v) {
      value <- tryCatch(
        .growth_expectation(spec, stats, .growth_unpack(spec, v, start))$log_likelihood,
        latents_singular_covariance = function(condition) -Inf)
      if (is.finite(value)) -value else .Machine$double.xmax
    }
    gradient <- function(v) {
      current <- .growth_unpack(spec, v, start)
      tryCatch(-colSums(.growth_scores(spec, stats, current) * weights),
               latents_singular_covariance = function(condition) rep(0, length(v)))
    }
    fitted <- stats::optim(theta, objective, gradient, method = "L-BFGS-B",
                           lower = bounds$lower, upper = bounds$upper,
                           control = list(maxit = max(100L, max_iter),
                                          factr = 10, pgtol = 0))
    list(params = .growth_unpack(spec, fitted$par, start), value = -fitted$value,
         iterations = as.integer(fitted$counts[["gradient"]]))
  })
  best <- finishes[[which.max(vapply(finishes, `[[`, numeric(1), "value"))]]
  # L-BFGS-B stops on its relative tolerance a little short of the maximum,
  # as EM does: Newton steps on the analytic score finish it.
  newton <- .growth_correlated_newton(spec, stats, best$params, weights, bounds)
  expectation <- .growth_expectation(spec, stats, newton$params)
  if (length(newton$at_bound) > 0L) {
    warning(warningCondition(sprintf(paste(
      "With correlated residuals, %s %s at %s floor (`min_variance`) or bound,",
      "or not identified: the data cannot separate the residual variance, the",
      "process and the random effects there. Their standard errors are not",
      "reported."),
      paste(sprintf("`%s`", newton$at_bound), collapse = ", "),
      if (length(newton$at_bound) == 1L) "is" else "are",
      if (length(newton$at_bound) == 1L) "its" else "their"),
      class = "latents_random_boundary", call = NULL))
  }
  if (!newton$converged) {
    warning(warningCondition(sprintf(paste(
      "The correlated-residual model did not converge (largest score %.3g",
      "standard errors from its root); the estimates are not a maximum."),
      newton$displacement), class = "latents_unconverged", call = NULL))
  }
  fit <- uncorrelated
  fit$spec <- spec
  fit$stats <- stats
  fit$params <- newton$params
  fit$expectation <- expectation
  fit$log_likelihood <- expectation$log_likelihood
  fit$n_parameters <- .growth_count_parameters(spec)
  degenerate <- .growth_degenerate_covariances(spec, newton$params)
  fit$degenerate_classes <- degenerate
  fit$residual_boundary <- newton$at_bound
  fit$random_boundary <- length(degenerate) > 0L || length(newton$at_bound) > 0L
  fit$converged <- newton$converged
  fit$iterations <- uncorrelated$iterations + best$iterations + newton$iterations
  fit$history <- c(uncorrelated$history, fit$log_likelihood)
  fit
}

.growth_correlated_refit <- function(spec, uncorrelated, max_iter, tol) {
  stats <- .growth_statistics(spec)
  base <- uncorrelated$params
  gaps <- unlist(lapply(stats$raw$rows, function(r) diff(sort(spec$residual_times[r]))))
  gap <- if (any(gaps > 0)) stats::median(gaps[gaps > 0]) else 1
  floor <- spec$min_variance
  starts <- lapply(c(0.5, 2) / gap, function(rate) {
    params <- base
    params$sigma2 <- pmax(base$sigma2 / 2, 2 * floor)
    sd <- sqrt(max(mean(base$sigma2) / 2, 2 * floor))
    params$correlation <- if (identical(spec$residual_correlation, "ar"))
      c(rate = rate, sd = sd) else c(sd = sd)
    params
  })
  if (identical(spec$residual_correlation, "brownian")) starts <- starts[1L]
  weights <- spec$sampling_weights %||% 1
  bounds <- .growth_correlated_bounds(spec, .growth_pack(spec, starts[[1L]]), gap)
  finishes <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
    theta <- pmin(pmax(.growth_pack(spec, start), bounds$lower), bounds$upper)
    # V = Z G Z' + W + sigma^2 I is positive definite in exact arithmetic, but
    # a line search can try a process variance so far beyond sigma^2 that it
    # is singular in floating point, or overflows: either is a rejected step.
    objective <- function(v) {
      value <- tryCatch(
        .growth_expectation(spec, stats, .growth_unpack(spec, v, start))$log_likelihood,
        latents_singular_covariance = function(condition) -Inf)
      if (is.finite(value)) -value else .Machine$double.xmax
    }
    gradient <- function(v) {
      current <- .growth_unpack(spec, v, start)
      tryCatch(-colSums(.growth_scores(spec, stats, current) * weights),
               latents_singular_covariance = function(condition) rep(0, length(v)))
    }
    fitted <- stats::optim(theta, objective, gradient, method = "L-BFGS-B",
                           lower = bounds$lower, upper = bounds$upper,
                           control = list(maxit = max(100L, max_iter),
                                          factr = 10, pgtol = 0))
    list(params = .growth_unpack(spec, fitted$par, start), value = -fitted$value,
         iterations = as.integer(fitted$counts[["gradient"]]))
  })
  best <- finishes[[which.max(vapply(finishes, `[[`, numeric(1), "value"))]]
  # L-BFGS-B stops on its relative tolerance a little short of the maximum,
  # as EM does: Newton steps on the analytic score finish it.
  newton <- .growth_correlated_newton(spec, stats, best$params, weights, bounds)
  expectation <- .growth_expectation(spec, stats, newton$params)
  if (length(newton$at_bound) > 0L) {
    warning(warningCondition(sprintf(paste(
      "With correlated residuals, %s %s at %s floor (`min_variance`) or bound,",
      "or not identified: the data cannot separate the residual variance, the",
      "process and the random effects there. Their standard errors are not",
      "reported."),
      paste(sprintf("`%s`", newton$at_bound), collapse = ", "),
      if (length(newton$at_bound) == 1L) "is" else "are",
      if (length(newton$at_bound) == 1L) "its" else "their"),
      class = "latents_random_boundary", call = NULL))
  }
  if (!newton$converged) {
    warning(warningCondition(sprintf(paste(
      "The correlated-residual model did not converge (largest score %.3g",
      "standard errors from its root); the estimates are not a maximum."),
      newton$displacement), class = "latents_unconverged", call = NULL))
  }
  fit <- uncorrelated
  fit$spec <- spec
  fit$stats <- stats
  fit$params <- newton$params
  fit$expectation <- expectation
  fit$log_likelihood <- expectation$log_likelihood
  fit$n_parameters <- .growth_count_parameters(spec)
  degenerate <- .growth_degenerate_covariances(spec, newton$params)
  fit$degenerate_classes <- degenerate
  fit$residual_boundary <- newton$at_bound
  fit$random_boundary <- length(degenerate) > 0L || length(newton$at_bound) > 0L
  fit$converged <- newton$converged
  fit$iterations <- uncorrelated$iterations + best$iterations + newton$iterations
  fit$history <- c(uncorrelated$history, fit$log_likelihood)
  fit
}

#' Newton steps on the correlated growth likelihood
#'
#' The information is the central-difference Jacobian of the analytic total
#' score, restricted to the coordinates not on a bound; each step is halved
#' until the likelihood does not decrease, and clipped to the bounds.
#' Converged when every free score times its standard error (the estimate's
#' distance from the root in standard-error units) is below 1e-4, a
#' hundredth of the displacement at which parameter_inference() warns.
#'
#' @return A list with `params`, `iterations`, `converged`, `displacement`
#'   and `at_bound` (the coordinates left on a bound).
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_correlated_newton <- function(spec, stats, params, weights, bounds,
                                      max_steps = 25L) {
  log_likelihood <- function(v) {
    tryCatch(.growth_expectation(spec, stats, .growth_unpack(spec, v, params))$log_likelihood,
             latents_singular_covariance = function(condition) -Inf)
  }
  total <- function(v) {
    colSums(.growth_scores(spec, stats, .growth_unpack(spec, v, params)) * weights)
  }
  on_bound <- function(v, score) {
    width <- 1e-8 * (1 + abs(v))
    (v <= bounds$lower + width & score <= 0) | (v >= bounds$upper - width & score >= 0)
  }
  # The Newton direction and displacement on the free coordinates.
  newton_step <- function(v) {
    score <- total(v)
    free <- !on_bound(v, score)
    information <- .inference_score_information(total, v, 1e-5, scheme = "central",
                                                h_rule = "plus1")[free, free, drop = FALSE]
    inverse <- tryCatch(solve(information), error = function(condition) NULL)
    if (is.null(inverse) || any(diag(inverse) <= 0)) {
      return(list(direction = NULL, displacement = Inf, free = free))
    }
    direction <- numeric(length(v))
    direction[free] <- as.vector(inverse %*% score[free])
    list(direction = direction, free = free,
         displacement = max(abs(score[free]) * sqrt(diag(inverse))))
  }
  theta <- .growth_pack(spec, params)
  value <- log_likelihood(theta)
  iterations <- 0L
  step <- newton_step(theta)
  # Each step needs the last one's result, so they run in sequence.
  while (iterations < max_steps && !is.null(step$direction) &&
         step$displacement >= 1e-8) {  # nolint: undesirable_operator.
    accepted <- FALSE
    multiplier <- 1
    while (!accepted && multiplier > 1e-9) {  # nolint: undesirable_operator.
      candidate <- pmin(pmax(theta + multiplier * step$direction, bounds$lower),
                        bounds$upper)
      candidate_value <- log_likelihood(candidate)
      accepted <- is.finite(candidate_value) &&
        candidate_value >= value - 1e-10 * (1 + abs(value))
      multiplier <- multiplier / 2
    }
    if (!accepted) break
    theta <- candidate
    value <- candidate_value
    iterations <- iterations + 1L
    step <- newton_step(theta)
  }
  score <- total(theta)
  at_bound <- names(theta)[on_bound(theta, score)]
  displacement <- step$displacement
  if (displacement >= 1e-4) {
    # A process the data cannot tell from white noise (a fast rate) or from
    # nothing leaves a flat ridge in its two coordinates: the likelihood is
    # at its maximum in every other direction. That is reported as a
    # boundary of the process, not as non-convergence, when the other
    # coordinates meet the criterion with the process held.
    process <- startsWith(names(theta), "residual_correlation.")
    rest <- !process & !(names(theta) %in% at_bound)
    information <- .inference_score_information(total, theta, 1e-5, scheme = "central",
                                                h_rule = "plus1")[rest, rest, drop = FALSE]
    inverse <- tryCatch(solve(information), error = function(condition) NULL)
    held <- if (is.null(inverse) || any(diag(inverse) <= 0)) Inf else
      max(abs(score[rest]) * sqrt(diag(inverse)))
    if (held < 1e-4) {
      at_bound <- union(at_bound, names(theta)[process])
      displacement <- held
    }
  }
  list(params = .growth_unpack(spec, theta, params), iterations = iterations,
       displacement = displacement, converged = displacement < 1e-4,
       at_bound = at_bound)
}

  flat <- matrix(stats$zz, n_random^2, length(stats$n))

.growth_residuals <- function(stats, coefficients) {
  n_persons <- length(stats$n)
  n_columns <- length(coefficients)
  n_random <- dim(stats$zz)[1L]
  outer_coefficients <- as.vector(tcrossprod(coefficients))
  cross <- 2 * as.vector(stats$xy %*% coefficients)
  fitted_ss <- colSums(matrix(stats$xx, n_columns^2, n_persons) * outer_coefficients)
  rr <- stats$yy - cross + fitted_ss
  # X'Z is columns x random x persons; beta'X'Z is random x persons.

                                                   n_random * n_persons)),
                    n_random, n_persons)
  zr <- stats$zy - t(xz_beta)

  # more than about six digits. Ordinary-scale fits retain the fast path.
  unstable <- which(rr <= 1e-6 * (abs(stats$yy) + abs(cross) + abs(fitted_ss)))

    # The fixed-effects residual r = y - X beta: the direct form with zero
    # random-effect means.
    direct <- .growth_direct_residuals(stats, coefficients,
                                       matrix(0, n_persons, n_random), unstable)
    rr[unstable] <- direct$rr
    zr[unstable, ] <- direct$zr
  }

#' One class's per-person log densities and random-effect posteriors
#'
#' Persons who share a design (the same Z'Z, as in a balanced or
#' near-balanced study) share the q x q factorization, which is done once
#' per pattern; everything per person is then a vector operation.
#'
#' @param stats Output of `.growth_statistics()`.
#' @param coefficients The class's regression coefficients (class-specific,
#'   then common).
#' @param factor Lower Cholesky factor `L` of the class's random-effect
#'   covariance.
#' @param sigma2 The class's residual variance.
#' @return A list with `log_density` (one per person), `mean` (persons by
#'   random effects: posterior means of b_i), `covariance` (random by random
#'   by patterns: posterior covariances) and the per-person `zr` and `rr`.
#' @noRd
before.definition_AST:
function(stats, coefficients, factor, sigma2) {
    n_random <- ncol(factor)
    residuals <- .growth_residuals(stats, coefficients)
    per_pattern <- lapply(seq_len(dim(stats$pattern_zz)[3L]), function(g) {
        zz <- matrix(stats$pattern_zz[, , g], n_random, n_random)
        a_factor <- chol(diag(n_random) + crossprod(factor, zz %*% factor)/sigma2)
        a_inverse <- chol2inv(a_factor)
        list(log_det = 2 * sum(log(diag(a_factor))), a_inverse = a_inverse, covariance = factor %*% a_inverse %*% t(factor))
    })
    pattern <- stats$pattern
    u <- residuals$zr %*% factor
    solved <- matrix(0, nrow(u), n_random)
    invisible(lapply(seq_along(per_pattern), function(g) {
        members <- which(pattern == g)
        solved[members, ] <<- u[members, , drop = FALSE] %*% per_pattern[[g]]$a_inverse
    }))
    log_det <- stats$n * log(sigma2) + vapply(per_pattern, `[[`, numeric(1), "log_det")[pattern]
    correction <- rowSums(u * solved)/sigma2
    quadratic <- (residuals$rr - correction)/sigma2
    means <- tcrossprod(solved, factor)/sigma2
    unstable <- which(quadratic <= 1e-06 * (abs(residuals$rr) + abs(correction))/sigma2)
    if (length(unstable) && !is.null(stats$raw)) {
        direct <- .growth_direct_residuals(stats, coefficients, means, unstable)
        quadratic[unstable] <- direct$rr/sigma2 + rowSums((solved[unstable, , drop = FALSE]/sigma2)^2)
    }

.growth_class_terms <- function(stats, coefficients, factor, sigma2) {
  n_random <- ncol(factor)
  residuals <- .growth_residuals(stats, coefficients)
  per_pattern <- lapply(seq_len(dim(stats$pattern_zz)[3L]), function(g) {
    zz <- matrix(stats$pattern_zz[, , g], n_random, n_random)
    a_factor <- chol(diag(n_random) + crossprod(factor, zz %*% factor) / sigma2)
    a_inverse <- chol2inv(a_factor)
    list(log_det = 2 * sum(log(diag(a_factor))), a_inverse = a_inverse,
         covariance = factor %*% a_inverse %*% t(factor))
  })
  pattern <- stats$pattern
  u <- residuals$zr %*% factor
  # A^-1 u, person by person through each person's pattern.
  solved <- matrix(0, nrow(u), n_random)
  invisible(lapply(seq_along(per_pattern), function(g) {
    members <- which(pattern == g)
    solved[members, ] <<- u[members, , drop = FALSE] %*% per_pattern[[g]]$a_inverse
  }))
  log_det <- stats$n * log(sigma2) +
    vapply(per_pattern, `[[`, numeric(1), "log_det")[pattern]
  correction <- rowSums(u * solved) / sigma2
  quadratic <- (residuals$rr - correction) / sigma2
  means <- tcrossprod(solved, factor) / sigma2
  unstable <- which(quadratic <=
    1e-6 * (abs(residuals$rr) + abs(correction)) / sigma2)
  if (length(unstable) && !is.null(stats$raw)) {
    # The Woodbury difference equals the penalized conditional residual:
    # ||r - Z L a||^2 / sigma2 + ||a||^2, a = A^-1 L'Z'r / sigma2.
    # Neither term subtracts two large squared quantities.
    direct <- .growth_direct_residuals(stats, coefficients, means, unstable)
    quadratic[unstable] <- direct$rr / sigma2 +
      rowSums((solved[unstable, , drop = FALSE] / sigma2)^2)
  }
  list(log_density = -0.5 * (stats$n * log(2 * pi) + log_det + quadratic),
       mean = means,
       covariance = array(vapply(per_pattern, `[[`, matrix(0, n_random, n_random),
                                 "covariance"),
                          c(n_random, n_random, length(per_pattern))),
       zr = residuals$zr, rr = residuals$rr)
}

before.name: .growth_maximization
before.documentation:
#' M-step of the growth mixture model (one conditional maximization each)
#'
#' Regression coefficients given the variances, then residual variances,
#' random-effect covariances and class shares: each step maximizes the
#' expected complete-data log likelihood with the random effects as missing
#' data (Laird and Ware 1982), so the likelihood never decreases.
#'
#' @return The updated parameter list.
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_maximization <- function(spec, stats, params, expectation) {
  n_classes <- spec$n_classes
  n_specific <- ncol(spec$x)
  n_common <- ncol(spec$z)
  n_columns <- n_specific + n_common
  n_random <- ncol(spec$random_design)
  n_persons <- length(stats$n)
  tau <- expectation$tau
  xx_flat <- matrix(stats$xx, n_columns^2, n_persons)
  zz_flat <- matrix(stats$zz, n_random^2, n_persons)
  # X_i'Z_i m_i for every person (columns by persons).
  xz_times <- function(means) {
    weighted <- array(matrix(stats$xz, n_columns, n_random * n_persons) *
                        rep(as.vector(t(means)), each = n_columns),
                      c(n_columns, n_random, n_persons))
    matrix(colSums(matrix(aperm(weighted, c(2L, 1L, 3L)), n_random)),
           n_columns, n_persons)
  }
  # Each person's m_i m_i', flattened like Z'Z (random^2 by persons).
  outer_means <- function(means) {
    t(means[, rep(seq_len(n_random), n_random), drop = FALSE] *
        means[, rep(seq_len(n_random), each = n_random), drop = FALSE])
  }
  # Weighted normal equations of every class, then the joint solve for the
  # class-specific and shared coefficients.
  blocks <- lapply(seq_len(n_classes), function(k) {
    weight <- tau[, k] / params$sigma2[k]
    list(gram = matrix(xx_flat %*% weight, n_columns, n_columns),
         right = as.vector(crossprod(stats$xy, weight) -
                             xz_times(expectation$means[[k]]) %*% weight))
  })
  specific <- seq_len(n_specific)
  shared <- n_specific + seq_len(n_common)
  size <- n_classes * n_specific + n_common
  common_at <- n_classes * n_specific + seq_len(n_common)
  system <- matrix(0, size, size)
  right <- numeric(size)
  invisible(lapply(seq_len(n_classes), function(k) {
    at <- (k - 1L) * n_specific + specific
    system[at, at] <<- blocks[[k]]$gram[specific, specific]
    right[at] <<- blocks[[k]]$right[specific]
    if (n_common > 0L) {
      system[at, common_at] <<- blocks[[k]]$gram[specific, shared]
      system[common_at, at] <<- blocks[[k]]$gram[shared, specific]
      system[common_at, common_at] <<- system[common_at, common_at] +
        blocks[[k]]$gram[shared, shared]
      right[common_at] <<- right[common_at] + blocks[[k]]$right[shared]
    }
  }))
  solution <- .mixture_solve(system, right)
  params$beta[] <- solution[seq_len(n_classes * n_specific)]
  if (n_common > 0L) params$common[] <- solution[common_at]

  # Expected residual sums of squares, per class, at the new coefficients:
  # E||y - X beta - Z b||^2 = r'r - 2 m'Z'r + m'Z'Z m + tr(Z'Z S).
  residual <- vapply(seq_len(n_classes), function(k) {
    residuals <- .growth_residuals(stats, .growth_coefficients(params, k))
    means <- expectation$means[[k]]
    covariance_flat <- matrix(expectation$covariances[[k]], n_random^2)
    cross <- 2 * rowSums(means * residuals$zr)
    fitted_ss <- colSums(zz_flat * outer_means(means))
    residual_ss <- residuals$rr - cross + fitted_ss
    unstable <- which(residual_ss <=
      1e-6 * (abs(residuals$rr) + abs(cross) + abs(fitted_ss)))
    if (length(unstable) && !is.null(stats$raw)) {
      residual_ss[unstable] <- .growth_direct_residuals(
        stats, .growth_coefficients(params, k), means, unstable)$rr
    }
    per_person <- residual_ss +
      colSums(zz_flat * covariance_flat[, stats$pattern, drop = FALSE])
    sum(tau[, k] * per_person)
  }, numeric(1))
  rows <- colSums(tau * stats$n)
  params$sigma2 <- if (identical(spec$variance, "equal")) {
    rep(sum(residual) / sum(rows), n_classes)
  } else residual / rows
  params$sigma2 <- pmax(params$sigma2, spec$min_variance)

  # Expected second moments of the random effects, per class.
  moments <- lapply(seq_len(n_classes), function(k) {
    means <- expectation$means[[k]]
    by_pattern <- as.vector(rowsum(tau[, k], stats$pattern, reorder = TRUE))
    crossprod(means * tau[, k], means) +
      matrix(matrix(expectation$covariances[[k]], n_random^2) %*% by_pattern,
             n_random, n_random)
  })
  sizes <- pmax(colSums(tau), .Machine$double.xmin)
  restrict <- function(covariance) {
    covariance <- (covariance + t(covariance)) / 2
    if (isTRUE(spec$random_diagonal)) covariance <- diag(diag(covariance), n_random)
    covariance
  }
  params$random_covariance <- switch(spec$random_covariance,
    varying = lapply(seq_len(n_classes), function(k) restrict(moments[[k]] / sizes[k])),
    equal = list(restrict(Reduce(`+`, moments) / sum(sizes))),
    proportional = {
      # Alternate the closed forms once: the shared matrix given the scales,
      # then each class's scale given the matrix (the last class's is 1).
      scale2 <- params$random_scale^2
      shared_matrix <- restrict(Reduce(`+`, Map(`/`, moments, scale2)) / sum(sizes))
      inverse <- .mixture_solve(shared_matrix, diag(n_random))
      updated <- vapply(seq_len(n_classes), function(k) {
        sum(inverse * moments[[k]]) / (n_random * sizes[k])
      }, numeric(1))
      # Re-express with the last class as the unit of scale; every class's
      # covariance s_k^2 G is unchanged by moving that factor into G.
      params$random_scale <- sqrt(pmax(updated / updated[n_classes], 1e-12))
      list(shared_matrix * updated[n_classes])
    })
  params$random_covariance <- lapply(params$random_covariance, function(covariance) {
    diag(covariance) <- pmax(diag(covariance), spec$min_variance)
    covariance
  })
  .mixture_update_mixing(.growth_structure(spec), params, expectation$structure)
}

before.documentation:
#' The latent structure of a growth mixture: classes over persons
#'
#' Each person's random effects are integrated out of their density, so the
#' persons are the units the classes belong to. Without clusters every person

#' Unpack an estimation vector into a growth-mixture parameter list

function(spec, theta, template) {
    n_classes <- spec$n_classes
    n_random <- ncol(spec$random_design)
    position <- 0L
    take <- function(count) {
        values <- theta[position + seq_len(count)]
        position <<- position + count
        unname(values)
    }
    params <- template
    params$beta[] <- take(length(params$beta))
    params$common[] <- take(length(params$common))
    sigma <- take(if (identical(spec$variance, "equal"))

        params$correlation[] <- exp(take(length(params$correlation)))
    }

#' Per-person scores of the growth mixture log likelihood

#' Analytic derivatives of each person's log likelihood on the estimation
#' scale. Within class k, with r = y - X beta, V^-1 r = (r - Z m) / sigma^2
#' (m the posterior mean of b), so

#' with Z'V^-1 Z = (Z'Z - Z'Z S Z'Z / sigma^2) / sigma^2 and S the posterior
#' covariance. The mixture weights each class's derivative by the person's
#' posterior.

#' @return A units-by-parameters matrix (unweighted by sampling weights): one
#'   row per person, or per cluster for a multilevel growth mixture.

.growth_inference.name: .growth_inference

before.name: .growth_inference
before.documentation:
#' Covariance of the growth mixture estimates
#'
#' The observed information is the numerical Jacobian of the analytic total
#' score; `"robust"` is the person-level sandwich, the only valid choice
#' under sampling weights.
#'
#' @param fit A `latents_growth_mixture` fit.
#' @param vcov_type `"observed"`, `"robust"` or `"opg"`.
#' @return A list with `theta`, `vcov`, `vcov_type`, `information` and
#'   `score_norm` (the largest absolute total score at the estimate).
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_inference <- function(fit, vcov_type = c("observed", "robust", "opg")) {
  vcov_type <- match.arg(vcov_type)
  spec <- fit$spec
  stats <- fit$stats
  params <- fit$params
  theta <- .growth_pack(spec, params)
  # One weight per independent unit (person, or cluster); unweighted, one.
  weights <- spec$sampling_weights %||% 1
  scores <- .growth_scores(spec, stats, params)
  n_units <- sum((spec$sampling_weights %||% rep(1, nrow(scores))) > 0)
  if (identical(vcov_type, "robust")) {
    .multilpa_require_clusters(n_units, length(theta),
                               "A robust growth covariance",
                               unit = "independent units")
    .inference_require_rank(scores * weights,
                             "The unit scores are rank deficient; robust inference is unavailable.")
  }
  total <- function(v) {
    colSums(.growth_scores(spec, stats, .growth_unpack(spec, v, params)) * weights)
  }
  # Weighted OPG, or central differences of the weighted total score with
  # h = 1e-5 * (1 + |theta|) (the service's "central"/"plus1" variant).
  information <- if (identical(vcov_type, "opg")) crossprod(scores * sqrt(weights)) else
    .inference_score_information(total, theta, 1e-5, scheme = "central",
                                 h_rule = "plus1")
  dimnames(information) <- list(names(theta), names(theta))
  # Coordinates a correlated fit left on a floor, a bound or a flat ridge are
  # held there: the others' covariance is that of the free block, and the
  # held ones get zero variance (their own rows are reported without one).
  free <- !names(theta) %in% (fit$residual_boundary %||% character())
  inverse <- matrix(0, length(theta), length(theta))
  inverse[free, free] <- .mixture_invert(information[free, free, drop = FALSE])
  vcov <- inverse
  if (identical(vcov_type, "robust")) {
    vcov[free, free] <- .inference_sandwich(
      inverse[free, free, drop = FALSE],
      crossprod(scores[, free, drop = FALSE] * weights), n_units)
  }
  dimnames(vcov) <- list(names(theta), names(theta))
  list(theta = theta, vcov = vcov, vcov_type = vcov_type, information = information,
       score_norm = max(abs(colSums(scores * weights))))
}
before.terminal_expression: list(theta = theta, vcov = vcov, vcov_type = vcov_type, information = information, score_norm = max(abs(colSums(scores * weights))))

#' Delta-method table of a transformation of the estimates
#'
#' Intervals are formed on `scale` (`"identity"`, `"log"` for variances and

#' carried back, so they respect the parameter's range.
#' @noRd

function(inference, transform, scale, level) {
    link <- switch(scale, identity = identity, log = log, atanh = atanh, logit = stats::qlogis)

    natural <- .mixture_delta(inference$theta, inference$vcov, transform)
    linked <- .mixture_delta(inference$theta, inference$vcov, function(v) link(transform(v)))
    z <- .inference_critical(level, "one_minus")
    data.frame(estimate = natural$estimate, std_error = natural$std_error, conf_low = inverse(linked$estimate - z * linked$std_error), conf_high = inverse(linked$estimate + z * linked$std_error))
}

}

#' Each cluster's group-class posteriors and modal group class
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_cluster_table <- function(x) {
  spec <- x$spec
  if (is.null(spec$cluster)) {
    return(data.frame(cluster = character(), group_class = character()))
  }
  rho <- x$expectation$structure$rho
  modal <- max.col(rho, ties.method = "first")
  out <- data.frame(cluster = spec$cluster_levels,
                    n_persons = tabulate(spec$cluster_index, spec$n_clusters),
                    group_class = paste0("group_class_", modal),
                    probability = rho[cbind(seq_along(modal), modal)],
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(out)[1L] <- spec$cluster
  posterior <- as.data.frame(rho)
  names(posterior) <- paste0("posterior_group_class_", seq_len(ncol(rho)))
  cbind(out, posterior)
}

before.documentation:
#' Every observation with its class trajectory and its person's own curve
#'
#' `class_mean` is the modal class's fixed trajectory; `predicted` adds the
#' person's predicted random effects (the conditional, empirical Bayes fit).
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_individual_table <- function(x, time = NULL) {
  view <- .trajectory_view(x)
  spec <- view$spec
  modal <- view$modal
  person <- spec$group_index
  design <- cbind(spec$x, spec$z)
  linear <- vapply(seq_len(spec$n), function(r) {
    sum(design[r, ] * .trajectory_coefficients(x, modal[person[r]]))
  }, numeric(1)) + spec$offset
  # With random effects, a person's own curve adds their predicted effects
  # under their most likely class; without, it is the class trajectory.
  own <- if (view$growth) {
    effects <- t(vapply(seq_len(spec$n), function(r) {
      x$expectation$means[[modal[person[r]]]][person[r], ]
    }, numeric(ncol(spec$random_design)))) |> matrix(spec$n)
    linear + rowSums(spec$random_design * effects)

#' Every observation with its class trajectory and its person's own curve
#'
#' `class_mean` is the modal class's fixed trajectory; `predicted` adds the
#' person's predicted random effects (the conditional, empirical Bayes fit).
#' @noRd
after.source:
.growth_individual_table <- function(x, time = NULL) {
  view <- .trajectory_view(x)
  spec <- view$spec
  modal <- view$modal
  person <- spec$group_index
  design <- cbind(spec$x, spec$z)
  linear <- vapply(seq_len(spec$n), function(r) {
    sum(design[r, ] * .trajectory_coefficients(x, modal[person[r]]))
  }, numeric(1)) + spec$offset
  # With random effects, a person's own curve adds their predicted effects
  # under their most likely class; without, it is the class trajectory.
  own <- if (view$growth) {
    effects <- t(vapply(seq_len(spec$n), function(r) {
      x$expectation$means[[modal[person[r]]]][person[r], ]
    }, numeric(ncol(spec$random_design)))) |> matrix(spec$n)
    linear + rowSums(spec$random_design * effects)
  } else linear
  out <- data.frame(id = spec$model_data[[spec$id]], class = view$classes[modal[person]],
                    observed = .trajectory_observed(view),
                    class_mean = view$response_mean(linear, modal[person]),
                    predicted = view$response_mean(own, modal[person]),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(out)[1L] <- spec$id
  time <- .growth_time_variable(x, time)
  out[[time]] <- spec$model_data[[time]]
  out[c(spec$id, time, "class", "observed", "class_mean", "predicted")]
}

#' Attach the printed layout of a growth table
#'
#' The data are untouched; this only chooses the title, columns, labels and
#' number formats `print()` uses.
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_present <- function(table, what, level, x) {
  column <- .latents_column
  interval <- function(low, high, from) {
    column(sprintf("%s%% CI", format(100 * level)), c(low, high), "ci", from)
  }
  percent <- format(100 * level)
  id <- x$spec$id
  time <- if (identical(what, "trajectories")) names(table)[2L] else if (
    identical(what, "individual")) names(table)[2L] else NULL
  # The recovery table's second column is the caller's truth column.
  truth_label <- if (identical(what, "recovery")) names(table)[2L] else NULL
  plan <- switch(what,
    coefficients = list(
      title = sprintf("Trajectory coefficients (%s%% CI)", percent),
      display = list(column("Class", "class", "label"), column("Term", "term", "label"),
                     column("Estimate", "estimate"),
                     interval("conf_low", "conf_high", "estimate"),
                     column("p", "p_value", "p"))),
    classes = list(
      title = "Classes",
      display = list(column("Class", "class", "label"), column("Share", "share"),
                     interval("share_conf_low", "share_conf_high", "share"),
                     column("Persons", "assigned_persons", "integer"),
                     column("Avg. posterior", "average_posterior"),
                     column("Residual SD", "residual_sd"))),
    random = list(
      title = sprintf("Random effects (%s%% CI)", percent),
      display = list(column("Class", "class", "label"),
                     column("Parameter", "parameter", "label"),
                     column("Term", "term", "label"), column("Estimate", "estimate"),
                     interval("conf_low", "conf_high", "estimate"))),
    membership = list(
      title = sprintf("Class membership (log odds against Class 1, %s%% CI)", percent),
      display = list(column("Class", "class", "label"), column("Term", "term", "label"),
                     column("Estimate", "estimate"),
                     interval("conf_low", "conf_high", "estimate"),
                     column("p", "p_value", "p"))),
    fit = list(
      title = "Model fit",
      display = list(column("Classes", "n_classes", "integer"),
                     if (!is.null(x$spec$cluster))
                       column("Group classes", "n_group_classes", "integer"),
                     if (!is.null(x$spec$cluster))
                       column("Clusters", "n_clusters", "integer"),
                     column("Persons", "n_persons", "integer"),
                     column("Observations", "n_observations", "integer"),
                     column("Random effects", "random", "text"),
                     column("Covariance", "random_covariance", "text"),
                     column("Parameters", "n_parameters", "integer"),
                     column("Log likelihood", "log_likelihood"),
                     column("AIC", "aic"), column("BIC", "bic"), column("SABIC", "sabic"),
                     column("ICL", "icl"), column("Entropy", "entropy"),
                     column("Smallest class", "smallest_share", "percent"),
                     column("Converged", "converged", "logical"),
                     column("Boundary", "random_boundary", "logical"))),
    assignments = list(
      title = "Class assignments",
      display = list(column(id, id, "text"),
                     if (!is.null(x$spec$cluster))
                       column(x$spec$cluster, x$spec$cluster, "text"),
                     column("Class", "class", "label"),
                     column("Probability", "probability"))),
    random_effects = list(
      title = "Predicted random effects (most likely class)",
      display = c(list(column(id, id, "text"), column("Class", "class", "label")),
                  lapply(colnames(x$spec$random_design), function(term) {
                    column(.latents_label(term), term)
                  }))),
    trajectories = list(
      title = sprintf("Class trajectories (%s%% CI)", percent),
      display = list(column("Class", "class", "label"), column(time, time),
                     column("Estimate", "estimate"),
                     interval("conf_low", "conf_high", "estimate"))),
    individual = list(
      title = "Observations with fitted trajectories",
      display = list(column(id, id, "text"), column(time, time),
                     column("Class", "class", "label"), column("Observed", "observed"),
                     column("Class mean", "class_mean"), column("Predicted", "predicted"))),
    starts = list(title = "Starts", display = NULL),
    group_classes = list(
      title = "Group classes: trajectory classes within each",
      display = list(column("Group class", "group_class", "label"),
                     column("Class", "class", "label"),
                     column("Probability", "probability", "share"),
                     column("SE", "std_error", "share"),
                     column("Share of clusters", "group_share", "share"),
                     column("Clusters", "assigned_clusters", "integer"))),
    clusters = list(
      title = "Cluster group classes",
      display = list(column(x$spec$cluster %||% "cluster", x$spec$cluster %||% "cluster",
                            "text"),
                     column("Persons", "n_persons", "integer"),
                     column("Group class", "group_class", "label"),
                     column("Probability", "probability"))),
    recovery = list(
      title = "Recovery of a known classification",
      display = list(column("Assigned", "assigned", "label"),
                     column(truth_label, truth_label, "text"),
                     column("Persons", "n", "integer"),
                     column("Share of assigned", "share", "share"))))
  # Columns a single-level fit does not have are NULL in the plan.
  display <- if (is.null(plan$display)) NULL else Filter(Negate(is.null), plan$display)
  table <- .latents_table(table, level, plan$title, display)
  if (identical(what, "fit")) attr(table, "card") <- TRUE
  if (identical(what, "random")) {
    attr(table, "marks") <- ifelse(table$boundary, "  boundary: no interval", "")
  }
  table
}

#' @noRd

#' @export
before.source:
confint.latents_growth_mixture <- function(object, parm, level = 0.95, ...) {
  inference <- .growth_resolve_inference(object)
  table <- .inference_wald(unname(inference$theta),
                         sqrt(pmax(diag(inference$vcov), 0)), level)
  out <- data.frame(parameter = names(inference$theta),
                    table[c("estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high")],
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (missing(parm)) return(out)
  out <- out[.mixture_confint_rows(parm, names(inference$theta)), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

.growth_natural_parameters.name: .growth_natural_parameters

before.name: .growth_natural_parameters
before.documentation:
#' The natural parameters of a growth fit, each as a function of the parameters
#'
#' Coefficients and membership logits are coordinates of the estimation
#' vector; residual standard deviations, random-effect variances, standard
#' deviations and correlations, and class shares are transformations of it.
#' Each row carries the scale its Wald interval is formed on, and whether a
#' Wald test of zero is meaningful (not for a variance, whose zero is a bound).
#'
#' @param x A `latents_growth_mixture` fit.
#' @return A list with `labels` (a data frame: `block`, `class`, `term`),
#'   `scales`, `tested` and `values`, a function of a parameter list and its
#'   specification returning every natural parameter in row order.
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_natural_parameters <- function(x) {
  spec <- x$spec
  names_theta <- .growth_names(spec)
  classes <- .growth_class_names(x)
  n_classes <- spec$n_classes
  terms <- colnames(spec$random_design)
  n_random <- length(terms)
  split_name <- function(names, prefix) {
    parts <- strsplit(sub(prefix, "", names), ".", fixed = TRUE)
    data.frame(class = vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 1L),
               term = vapply(parts, function(p) paste(p[-1L], collapse = "."),
                             character(1)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  coefficient_names <- names_theta[startsWith(names_theta, "coefficient.")]
  membership_names <- names_theta[startsWith(names_theta, "membership.") |
                                    startsWith(names_theta, "group_membership.")]
  sd_classes <- if (identical(spec$variance, "equal")) 1L else seq_len(n_classes)
  random_classes <- if (identical(spec$random_covariance, "equal")) 1L else
    seq_len(n_classes)
  pairs <- if (isTRUE(spec$random_diagonal)) matrix(integer(), 0L, 2L) else
    which(upper.tri(diag(n_random)), arr.ind = TRUE)
  class_label <- function(k, shared) if (shared) "all" else classes[k]
  random_labels <- do.call(rbind, lapply(random_classes, function(k) {
    shared <- identical(spec$random_covariance, "equal")
    rbind(
      data.frame(block = "random_variance", class = class_label(k, shared),
                 term = terms, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
      data.frame(block = "random_sd", class = class_label(k, shared),
                 term = terms, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
      data.frame(block = rep("random_correlation", nrow(pairs)),
                 class = rep(class_label(k, shared), nrow(pairs)),
                 term = paste(terms[pairs[, 1L]], terms[pairs[, 2L]], sep = ":"),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }))
  labels <- rbind(
    cbind(block = "coefficient", split_name(coefficient_names, "^coefficient\\.")),
    if (length(membership_names) > 0L)
      cbind(block = ifelse(startsWith(membership_names, "group_"),
                           "group_membership", "membership"),
            split_name(membership_names, "^(group_)?membership\\.")),
    data.frame(block = "residual_sd",
               class = vapply(sd_classes, class_label, character(1),
                              shared = identical(spec$variance, "equal")),
               term = "residual", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    random_labels,
    data.frame(block = "share", class = classes, term = "share",
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    if (.growth_is_correlated(spec))
      data.frame(block = "residual_process", class = "all",
                 term = names(x$params$correlation), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  rownames(labels) <- NULL
  scales <- c(coefficient = "identity", membership = "identity",
              group_membership = "identity", residual_sd = "log",
              random_variance = "log", random_sd = "log",
              random_correlation = "atanh", share = "logit",
              residual_process = "log")[labels$block]
  values <- function(params, spec) {
    theta <- .growth_pack(spec, params)
    covariances <- .growth_covariances(spec, params)
    random <- unlist(lapply(random_classes, function(k) {
      covariance <- covariances[[k]]
      variance <- diag(covariance)
      c(variance, sqrt(variance),
        covariance[pairs] / sqrt(variance[pairs[, 1L]] * variance[pairs[, 2L]]))
    }))
    weights <- spec$sampling_weights %||% rep(1, spec$n_groups)
    prior <- .growth_class_prior(spec, params)
    c(theta[coefficient_names], theta[membership_names],
      sqrt(params$sigma2[sd_classes]), random,
      colSums(prior * weights) / sum(weights),
      if (.growth_is_correlated(spec)) params$correlation) |> unname()
  }
  # A coordinate the correlated fit left on its floor or bound has no Wald or
  # bootstrap distribution worth reporting, as a degenerate covariance has not.
  on_bound <- x$residual_boundary %||% character()
  residual_held <- labels$block == "residual_sd" &
    any(startsWith(on_bound, "log_sigma.")) |
    labels$block == "residual_process" &
    sprintf("residual_correlation.log_%s", labels$term) %in% on_bound
  list(labels = labels, scales = unname(scales),
       tested = labels$block %in% c("coefficient", "membership", "group_membership"),
       degenerate = residual_held | labels$block %in% c("random_variance", "random_sd",
                                                        "random_correlation") &
         vapply(labels$class, function(label) {
           if (identical(label, "all")) length(x$degenerate_classes %||% character()) > 0L
           else .growth_class_is_degenerate(x, match(label, classes))
         }, logical(1)),
       values = values)
}

before.documentation:
#' The order that matches a refit's classes to the original fit's
#' @param x The original fit.
#' @param refit Another fit of the same model.
#' @return A list with `order` (new class `k` is the refit's class
#'   `order[k]`) and `posterior`, the refit's posteriors of the original
#'   persons in its own labels.
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_match_classes <- function(x, refit) {
  persons <- .growth_new_spec(refit, x$spec$model_data, TRUE)
  posterior <- .growth_expectation(persons, .growth_statistics(persons),
                                   refit$params)$posterior
  list(order = .multilpa_match_order(t(x$expectation$posterior), t(posterior)),
       posterior = posterior)
}

before.documentation:
#' Person bootstrap inference for a growth fit
#'
#' Persons are drawn with replacement (a person drawn twice is two persons),
#' each resample is refitted from fresh starts, and its classes are matched to
#' the original's before the natural parameters are read. A refit's start
#' failures, degenerate starts and boundary variances are expected and
#' muffled; one that does not converge is dropped with its reason.
#'
#' @return The bootstrap table and its attributes.
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_bootstrap_inference <- function(x, natural, level, iter, n_starts, max_iter,
                                        tol, adjust) {
  if (!is.null(x$spec$cluster)) {
    stop(errorCondition(paste(
      "The bootstrap is not implemented for a multilevel growth mixture: its",
      "replicates would also need their group classes matched. Use",
      "`method = \"wald\"`."), class = "latents_unsupported_inference", call = NULL))
  }
  spec <- x$spec
  data <- spec$model_data
  weight_column <- NULL
  if (.latents_is_weighted(x)) {
    weight_column <- ".latents_bootstrap_weight"
    data[[weight_column]] <- spec$sampling_weights[spec$group_index]
  }
  arguments <- .growth_refit_arguments(x, weight_column)
  muffled <- c("latents_failed_starts", "latents_degenerate_start",
               "latents_random_boundary", "latents_unconverged")
  drawn <- .latents_cluster_bootstrap(
    data, spec$group_index, spec$n_groups, spec$id, iter,
    refit = function(resampled) {
      withCallingHandlers(
        do.call(mixture_regression, c(list(data = resampled), arguments,
                                      list(n_starts = n_starts, max_iter = max_iter,
                                           tol = tol))),
        warning = function(w) {
          if (inherits(w, muffled)) invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        })
    },
    extract = function(refit) natural$values(.growth_align_refit(x, refit), refit$spec),
    reference_names = paste(natural$labels$block, natural$labels$class,
                            natural$labels$term, sep = "."))
  valid <- stats::complete.cases(drawn$estimates)
  if (sum(valid) < 2L) {
    reasons <- drawn$messages[!is.na(drawn$messages)]
    stop(errorCondition(sprintf(
      "Only %d of %d resamples produced a usable fit; the first reason was: %s",
      sum(valid), iter,
      if (length(reasons) > 0L) reasons[1L] else "no reason was recorded"),
      class = "latents_bootstrap_failed", call = NULL))
  }
  if (sum(valid) < iter) {
    warning(warningCondition(sprintf(
      "%d of %d resamples did not produce a usable fit and were dropped.",
      iter - sum(valid), iter), class = "latents_bootstrap_dropped", call = NULL))
  }
  kept <- drawn$estimates[valid, , drop = FALSE]
  bounds <- c((1 - level) / 2, (1 + level) / 2)
  quantiles <- apply(kept, 2L, stats::quantile, probs = bounds, names = FALSE)
  # A Wald statistic would put a normal approximation back on top of the
  # replicates the interval was read from: the interval is the inference.
  result <- data.frame(natural$labels,
                       estimate = natural$values(x$params, spec),
                       standard_error = apply(kept, 2L, stats::sd),
                       statistic = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, p_adjusted = NA_real_,
                       conf_low = quantiles[1L, ], conf_high = quantiles[2L, ],
                       row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  covariance <- stats::cov(kept)
  structure(result, covariance = covariance, level = level, method = "bootstrap",
            iter = iter, n_valid = sum(valid), replicates = kept,
            messages = drawn$messages, adjust = adjust)
}

before.name: parameter_inference.latents_growth_mixture
before.formal_defaults: as.pairlist(alist(x = , data = NULL, level = 0.95, step = 1e-04, vcov_type = c("observed", "robust", "opg"), adjust = .multilpa_p_adjust_methods, method = c("wald", "bootstrap"), iter = 199L, n_starts = 10L, max_iter = 1000L, tol = 1e-08, seed = NULL, boundary = c("error", "fix")))
before.documentation:
#' @details For a growth mixture ([mixture_regression()] with `random`), the
#'   table has one row per natural parameter: `block` (`"coefficient"`,
#'   `"membership"` and, for a multilevel growth mixture,
#'   `"group_membership"`, `"residual_sd"`, `"random_variance"`,
#'   `"random_sd"`, `"random_correlation"`, `"share"`), `class` (`"all"` for
#'   a quantity shared by every class), `term`, `estimate`, `standard_error`,
#'   `statistic`, `p_value`, `p_adjusted`, `conf_low` and `conf_high`. Wald
#'   rows use the fit's covariance (`vcov_type`) with the delta method;
#'   intervals of standard deviations and variances are formed on the log
#'   scale, of correlations on the Fisher scale and of shares on the logit
#'   scale, and only coefficients and logits are tested against zero.
#'   `method = "bootstrap"` resamples persons, refits each resample from
#'   `n_starts` starts and matches its classes to the original by their
#'   posterior memberships of the original persons; it is refused for a
#'   multilevel growth mixture (`latents_unsupported_inference`). In a
#'   simulation of 1000 datasets per design, Wald intervals covered
#'   0.936-0.965 with well-separated classes and 0.885-0.943 with weakly
#'   separated ones, whose standard errors were 6-30% too small
#'   (validation/GROWTH_SIMULATION.md in the source repository); the
#'   bootstrap is preferable for weakly separated classes. A class
#'   whose random-effect covariance is degenerate raises
#'   `latents_boundary_fit` under `boundary = "error"`; under `"fix"` its
#'   random-effect rows have no standard error or interval. `data`, when
#'   given, must be the fitted data; `step` is not used (the information is
#'   the derivative of the analytic score).
#' @rdname parameter_inference
#' @export
before.source:
parameter_inference.latents_growth_mixture <- function(
    x, data = NULL, level = 0.95, step = 1e-4,
    vcov_type = c("observed", "robust", "opg"),
    adjust = .multilpa_p_adjust_methods, method = c("wald", "bootstrap"),
    iter = 199L, n_starts = 10L, max_iter = 1000L, tol = 1e-8, seed = NULL,
    boundary = c("error", "fix")) {
  stopifnot(
    "`level` must be a single finite number in (0, 1)" =
      is.numeric(level) && length(level) == 1L && is.finite(level) &&
      level > 0 && level < 1,
    "`iter` must be a single whole number of at least 2" =
      is.numeric(iter) && length(iter) == 1L && is.finite(iter) && iter >= 2 &&
      iter == floor(iter))
  adjust <- match.arg(adjust)
  method <- match.arg(method)
  boundary <- match.arg(boundary)
  .multilpa_check_seed(seed)
  if (!is.null(data)) .trajectory_check_data(x, data)
  if (!isTRUE(x$converged)) {
    stop(errorCondition("The fit did not converge; infer from it only once it has.",
                        class = "latents_no_converge", call = NULL))
  }
  natural <- .growth_natural_parameters(x)
  if (any(natural$degenerate) && identical(boundary, "error")) {
    stop(errorCondition(paste(
      "A random-effect covariance is degenerate, so its parameters sit on a",
      "bound and have no Wald or bootstrap distribution worth reporting. Use",
      "`boundary = \"fix\"` to report the other parameters."),
      class = "latents_boundary_fit", call = NULL))
  }
  if (identical(method, "bootstrap")) {
    result <- .mixture_with_seed(seed, .growth_bootstrap_inference(
      x, natural, level, as.integer(iter), n_starts, max_iter, tol, adjust))
  } else {
    vcov_type <- if (missing(vcov_type)) NULL else match.arg(vcov_type)
    inference <- .growth_resolve_inference(x, vcov_type)
    spec <- x$spec
    rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(natural$labels)), function(row) {
      .growth_delta_table(inference, function(v) {
        natural$values(.growth_unpack(spec, v, x$params), spec)[row]
      }, natural$scales[row], level)
    })
    wald <- do.call(rbind, rows)
    statistic <- ifelse(natural$tested & wald$std_error > 0,
                        wald$estimate / wald$std_error, NA_real_)
    result <- data.frame(natural$labels, estimate = wald$estimate,
                         standard_error = wald$std_error, statistic = statistic,
                         p_value = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(statistic)),
                         p_adjusted = NA_real_,
                         conf_low = wald$conf_low, conf_high = wald$conf_high,
                         row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    attributes(result) <- c(attributes(result), list(
      covariance_unconstrained = inference$vcov, level = level, method = "wald",
      vcov_type = inference$vcov_type, adjust = adjust))
  }
  result[natural$degenerate, c("standard_error", "statistic", "p_value",
                               "conf_low", "conf_high")] <- NA_real_
  result$p_adjusted <- stats::p.adjust(result$p_value, method = adjust)
  result
}

before.name: .growth_spread
before.documentation:
#' Where `spread` of each class's persons' trajectories lie
#'
#' From the random effects alone: mean +- z sqrt(z(t)' G z(t)), with other
#' random-effect variables at their typical values.
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_spread <- function(x, bands, time, spread) {
  if (spread <= 0) return(NULL)
  grid <- unique(bands$trajectory_time)
  variables <- setdiff(all.vars(x$spec$random), x$spec$id)
  rows <- if (length(variables) == 0L) data.frame(row = seq_along(grid)) else
    .mixture_typical_rows(x$spec$model_data[unique(c(time, variables))], time, grid)
  random_design <- stats::model.matrix(x$spec$random, rows)
  covariances <- .growth_covariances(x$spec, x$params)
  z <- stats::qnorm(1 - (1 - spread) / 2)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(covariances), function(k) {
    variance <- rowSums((random_design %*% covariances[[k]]) * random_design)
    mean <- bands$estimate[bands$class == .growth_class_names(x)[k]]
    data.frame(class = .growth_class_names(x)[k], trajectory_time = grid,
               spread_low = mean - z * sqrt(variance), spread_high = mean + z * sqrt(variance),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

before.documentation: #' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_plot_trajectories <- function(x, key, time, facet, max_persons, spread, level,
                                      main, subtitle) {
  time <- .growth_time_variable(x, time)
  bands <- as.data.frame(.growth_trajectory_table(x, level, .trajectory_inference(x),
                                                  time))
  bands$trajectory_time <- bands[[time]]
  label_of <- function(class) key$label[match(class, key$class)]
  bands$class_label <- label_of(bands$class)
  spread_band <- if (inherits(x, "latents_growth_mixture")) {
    .growth_spread(x, bands, time, spread)
  }
  means <- .growth_observed_means(x, time, level)
  observed <- as.data.frame(.growth_individual_table(x, time))
  observed$trajectory_time <- observed[[time]]
  observed$person <- observed[[x$spec$id]]
  people <- unique(observed[c("person", "class")])
  per_class <- floor(max_persons / nrow(key))
  shown <- if (per_class < 1L) NULL else
    unlist(lapply(split(people$person, people$class), function(ids) {
      ids[unique(round(seq(1, length(ids), length.out = min(length(ids), per_class))))]
    }), use.names = FALSE)
  observed <- observed[observed$person %in% shown, , drop = FALSE]
  observed <- observed[order(observed$person, observed$trajectory_time), , drop = FALSE]
  observed$class_label <- label_of(observed$class)
  layers <- list()
  if (nrow(observed) > 0L) {
    layers$persons <- ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = observed, ggplot2::aes(trajectory_time, observed, group = person,
                                    colour = class_label),
      alpha = 0.10, linewidth = 0.3)
  }
  if (!is.null(spread_band)) {
    spread_band$class_label <- label_of(spread_band$class)
    layers$spread <- ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      data = spread_band, ggplot2::aes(trajectory_time, ymin = spread_low,
                                       ymax = spread_high, fill = class_label),
      alpha = 0.10)
  }
  layers$band <- ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
    data = bands, ggplot2::aes(trajectory_time, ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high,
                               fill = class_label), alpha = 0.30)
  layers$mean <- ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = bands, ggplot2::aes(trajectory_time, estimate, colour = class_label,
                               linetype = class_label), linewidth = 1.3)
  if (!is.null(means)) {
    means$class_label <- label_of(means$class)
    layers$observed_errors <- ggplot2::geom_linerange(
      data = means, ggplot2::aes(trajectory_time, ymin = observed_low, ymax = observed_high,
                                 colour = class_label), linewidth = 0.5)
    layers$observed_means <- ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = means, ggplot2::aes(trajectory_time, observed_mean, fill = class_label,
                                 shape = class_label), colour = "white", size = 2.4,
      stroke = 0.5)
  }
  caption <- paste(c(
    sprintf("Line and dark band: class mean trajectory and its %s%% confidence band.",
            format(100 * level)),
    if (!is.null(spread_band))
      sprintf("Light band: where %s%% of the class's persons' trajectories lie.",
              format(100 * spread)),
    if (!is.null(means)) "Points: observed class means (posterior-weighted) with intervals.",
    if (nrow(observed) > 0L) "Thin lines: persons, coloured by their most likely class."),
    collapse = "\n")
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() + layers + .growth_scales(key) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = time, y = x$spec$response_name) + .gg_theme()
  description <- if (inherits(x, "latents_growth_mixture")) {
    sprintf("%d persons, %d classes; random %s (%s covariance)", length(x$stats$n),
            x$spec$n_classes, .growth_random_description(x$spec), x$spec$random_covariance)
  } else {
    sprintf("%d persons, %d classes; no random effects (latent class growth)",
            x$spec$n_groups, x$spec$n_classes)
  }
  if (isTRUE(facet)) {
    return(plot + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ class_label) +
             .gg_titles(main, subtitle, "Class trajectories", description,
                        caption = caption))
  }
  ends <- bands[bands$trajectory_time == max(bands$trajectory_time), , drop = FALSE]
  span <- diff(range(c(bands$conf_low, bands$conf_high,
                       spread_band$spread_low, spread_band$spread_high)))
  ends$label_y <- .gg_spread(ends$estimate, 0.07 * span)
  right <- max(bands$trajectory_time)
  width <- diff(range(bands$trajectory_time))
  plot +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = ends,
                       ggplot2::aes(right + 0.02 * width, label_y, label = class_label,
                                    colour = class_label),
                       hjust = 0, size = 3.7, fontface = "bold") +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 115, 10, 12)) +
    .gg_titles(main, subtitle, "Class trajectories", description, caption = caption)
}

.growth_plot_random <- function(x, key, main, subtitle) {
  effects <- as.data.frame(.growth_random_effects_table(x))
  terms <- colnames(x$spec$random_design)
  effects$class_label <- key$label[match(effects$class, key$class)]
  covariances <- .growth_covariances(x$spec, x$params)
  flagged <- key$class[vapply(seq_len(nrow(key)), function(k) {
    .growth_class_is_degenerate(x, k)
  }, logical(1))]
  notes <- if (length(flagged) > 0L) {
    data.frame(class_label = key$label[match(flagged, key$class)],
               note = "Degenerate covariance: not separable from zero or each other",
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  if (length(terms) == 1L) {
    effects$effect_x <- effects[[terms[1L]]]
    # A deterministic vertical spread (golden-ratio offsets of each person's
    # rank within their class), as the case strips use: no random jitter, so
    # the plot is the same on every draw and draws nothing from the RNG.
    row_of <- function(label) as.integer(factor(label, levels = levels(key$label)))
    within <- stats::ave(effects$effect_x, effects$class,
                         FUN = \(v) rank(v, ties.method = "first"))
    effects$effect_y <- row_of(effects$class_label) + 0.36 * ((within * 0.618) %% 1 - 0.5)
    plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(effects, ggplot2::aes(effect_x, effect_y,
                                                  colour = class_label)) +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(fill = class_label, shape = class_label),
                          colour = "white", alpha = 0.85, size = 2, stroke = 0.3) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(key$label)),
                                  labels = levels(key$label)) +
      .growth_scales(key) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = sprintf("Predicted random effect: %s", terms[1L]), y = NULL) +
      .gg_theme() +
      .gg_titles(main, subtitle, "Predicted random effects",
                 "Each point is a person's deviation from their class trajectory")
    if (!is.null(notes)) {
      notes$effect_y <- row_of(notes$class_label)
      plot <- plot + ggplot2::geom_text(data = notes,
                                        ggplot2::aes(y = effect_y, label = note),
                                        x = Inf, hjust = 1.02, vjust = -1.2, size = 3.1,
                                        colour = "#D55E00", inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }
    return(plot)
  }
  effects$effect_x <- effects[[terms[1L]]]
  effects$effect_y <- effects[[terms[2L]]]
  ellipses <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(key)), function(k) {
    shape <- .gg_ellipse(c(0, 0), covariances[[k]][1:2, 1:2])
    data.frame(effect_x = shape$x, effect_y = shape$y, class_label = key$label[k],
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(effects, ggplot2::aes(effect_x, effect_y, colour = class_label)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(data = ellipses, ggplot2::aes(linetype = class_label),
                       linewidth = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(fill = class_label, shape = class_label),
                        colour = "white", alpha = 0.85, size = 1.9, stroke = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ class_label) +
    .growth_scales(key) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = sprintf("Random effect: %s", terms[1L]),
                  y = sprintf("Random effect: %s", terms[2L])) +
    .gg_theme() +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey92",
                                                              linewidth = 0.3)) +
    .gg_titles(main, subtitle, "Predicted random effects",
               paste("Each point is a person's deviation from their class trajectory;",
                     "the ellipse holds 95% of the class's random effects"))
  if (!is.null(notes)) {
    plot <- plot + ggplot2::geom_text(data = notes, ggplot2::aes(label = note),
                                      x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.03, vjust = 1.6,
                                      size = 3.1, colour = "#D55E00", inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  plot
}

.growth_plot_classification <- function(x, key, main, subtitle) {
  posterior <- .trajectory_view(x)$posterior
  classes <- .growth_class_names(x)
  modal <- max.col(posterior, ties.method = "first")
  certainty <- posterior[cbind(seq_along(modal), modal)]
  # Persons ordered by their class (largest first) and, within it, certainty.
  ordering <- order(key$rank[modal], -certainty)
  position <- integer(length(modal))
  position[ordering] <- seq_along(ordering)
  long <- data.frame(
    position = rep(position, times = length(classes)),
    class_label = rep(key$label[modal], times = length(classes)),
    posterior_class = rep(key$label, each = length(modal)),
    probability = as.vector(posterior), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # A second channel besides the fill: every class's band is named directly on
  # the bar of each panel's least certain person, where the competing classes
  # are widest. Bars stack the first legend level on top, so a band's centre
  # is the mass of the levels after it plus half its own; bands too thin to
  # hold a name stay unlabelled.
  middle <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(classes), function(k) {
    members <- which(modal == k)
    if (length(members) == 0L) return(integer())
    members[which.max(position[members])]
  }))
  stack_order <- match(levels(key$label), as.character(key$label))
  names_on_bars <- do.call(rbind, lapply(middle, function(i) {
    shares <- posterior[i, stack_order]
    below <- rev(cumsum(rev(shares))) - shares
    data.frame(position = position[i], class_label = key$label[modal[i]],
               name = sub(" \\(.*", "", levels(key$label)),
               centre = below + shares / 2, share = shares,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  names_on_bars <- names_on_bars[names_on_bars$share >= 0.12, , drop = FALSE]
  average <- vapply(seq_along(classes), function(k) mean(certainty[modal == k]), numeric(1))
  subtitle_text <- paste0("One bar per person, split by their class probabilities. ",
                          "Average probability of the assigned class: ",
                          paste(sprintf("%s %.2f", sub(" \\(.*", "", key$label), average),
                                collapse = ", "))
  ggplot2::ggplot(long, ggplot2::aes(position, probability, fill = posterior_class)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 1, colour = NA) +
    ggplot2::geom_label(data = names_on_bars,
                        ggplot2::aes(position, centre, label = name),
                        hjust = 1, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 3,
                        label.padding = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "pt"),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(~ class_label, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
    .growth_scales(key, legend = TRUE)[2L] +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Persons, by assigned class and certainty",
                  y = "Posterior probability") +
    .gg_theme() + .gg_top_legend() +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.spacing.x = ggplot2::unit(6, "pt"),
                   panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank()) +
    .gg_titles(main, subtitle, "Classification", subtitle_text)
}

.growth_plot_classification <- function(x, key, main, subtitle) {
  posterior <- .trajectory_view(x)$posterior
  classes <- .growth_class_names(x)
  modal <- max.col(posterior, ties.method = "first")
  certainty <- posterior[cbind(seq_along(modal), modal)]
  # Persons ordered by their class (largest first) and, within it, certainty.
  ordering <- order(key$rank[modal], -certainty)
  position <- integer(length(modal))
  position[ordering] <- seq_along(ordering)
  long <- data.frame(
    position = rep(position, times = length(classes)),
    class_label = rep(key$label[modal], times = length(classes)),
    posterior_class = rep(key$label, each = length(modal)),
    probability = as.vector(posterior), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # A second channel besides the fill: every class's band is named directly on
  # the bar of each panel's least certain person, where the competing classes
  # are widest. Bars stack the first legend level on top, so a band's centre
  # is the mass of the levels after it plus half its own; bands too thin to
  # hold a name stay unlabelled.
  middle <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(classes), function(k) {
    members <- which(modal == k)
    if (length(members) == 0L) return(integer())
    members[which.max(position[members])]
  }))
  stack_order <- match(levels(key$label), as.character(key$label))
  names_on_bars <- do.call(rbind, lapply(middle, function(i) {
    shares <- posterior[i, stack_order]
    below <- rev(cumsum(rev(shares))) - shares
    data.frame(position = position[i], class_label = key$label[modal[i]],
               name = sub(" \\(.*", "", levels(key$label)),
               centre = below + shares / 2, share = shares,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  names_on_bars <- names_on_bars[names_on_bars$share >= 0.12, , drop = FALSE]
  average <- vapply(seq_along(classes), function(k) mean(certainty[modal == k]), numeric(1))
  subtitle_text <- paste0("One bar per person, split by their class probabilities. ",
                          "Average probability of the assigned class: ",
                          paste(sprintf("%s %.2f", sub(" \\(.*", "", key$label), average),
                                collapse = ", "))
  ggplot2::ggplot(long, ggplot2::aes(position, probability, fill = posterior_class)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 1, colour = NA) +
    ggplot2::geom_label(data = names_on_bars,
                        ggplot2::aes(position, centre, label = name),
                        hjust = 1, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 3,
                        label.padding = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "pt"),
                        inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(~ class_label, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
    .growth_scales(key, legend = TRUE)[2L] +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Persons, by assigned class and certainty",
                  y = "Posterior probability") +
    .gg_theme() + .gg_top_legend() +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.spacing.x = ggplot2::unit(6, "pt"),
                   panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank()) +
    .gg_titles(main, subtitle, "Classification", subtitle_text)
}

before.documentation:
#' Rebuild a growth specification on new persons
#'
#' The fitted terms, factor levels and membership codings evaluate `newdata`,
#' so its design columns follow the fitted order. Every person in `newdata` is
#' a new person, and in a multilevel growth mixture every cluster is a new
#' cluster, classified from its own persons.
#'
#' @param object A `latents_growth_mixture` fit.
#' @param newdata A data frame with the predictors, `id` (and `cluster`).
#' @param with_response Whether the outcome must be present.
#' @return A growth specification for the engine, without sampling weights.
#' @noRd
before.source:
.growth_new_spec <- function(object, newdata, with_response) {
  spec <- object$spec
  new <- .mixture_prediction_data(.mixture_new_spec(object, newdata, with_response))
  random_frame <- .mixture_prediction_data(
    stats::model.frame(spec$random, newdata, na.action = stats::na.fail))
  new$random_design <- stats::model.matrix(spec$random, random_frame)
  if (!identical(colnames(new$random_design), colnames(spec$random_design)) ||
      any(!is.finite(new$random_design))) {
    stop(errorCondition(paste(
      "The random-effects design of `newdata` must be finite and have the",
      "fitted columns."), class = "latents_bad_data", call = NULL))
  }
  new$sampling_weights <- NULL
  new$row_weights <- NULL
  if (.growth_is_correlated(spec)) {
    times <- newdata[[spec$residual_time]]
    if (is.null(times) || anyNA(times) || any(!is.finite(times))) {
      stop(errorCondition(sprintf(
        "`newdata` needs the residual time column `%s`, finite on every row.",
        spec$residual_time), class = "latents_bad_data", call = NULL))
    }
    new$residual_times <- times
  }
  if (!is.null(spec$cluster)) {
    if (!spec$cluster %in% names(newdata) || anyNA(newdata[[spec$cluster]])) {
      stop(errorCondition(sprintf(
        "`newdata` needs the cluster column `%s`, without missing values.",
        spec$cluster), class = "latents_bad_data", call = NULL))
    }
    blueprint <- spec$group_membership_design
    frame <- .mixture_prediction_data(stats::model.frame(
      blueprint$terms, newdata, xlev = blueprint$xlevels, na.action = stats::na.fail))
    row_group <- stats::model.matrix(blueprint$terms, frame,
                                     contrasts.arg = blueprint$contrasts)
    row_membership <- new$w[new$group_index, , drop = FALSE]
    new <- utils::modifyList(new, .growth_cluster_spec(
      newdata[[spec$cluster]], new$group_index, row_membership, row_group,
      spec$n_cluster_classes, check_count = FALSE))
  }
  new
}
